item.title: Cyclone Verath makes landfall near Kalpore, 40,000 evacuated
item.description: Cyclone Verath crossed the coast near Kalpore early on Friday. State authorities said 40,000 people had been moved to relief camps. No deaths have been confirmed.

item.title: Kestrels through to final after 3-1 win over Harriers
item.description: A second-half hat-trick sent the Kestrels into the final. The match was played in front of 42,000 spectators.
